# GanttBoard for Jira

> A free, native Gantt chart for Jira Cloud, built on Atlassian Forge. It runs
> entirely inside the customer's own Atlassian Cloud tenant — no external
> servers, no data egress, no separate login, and no sync engine.

GanttBoard turns any Jira Cloud project into a working Gantt chart. Open a
project, click the GanttBoard tab, and the project's issues are already on a
timeline. There is no setup, no field mapping and nothing to configure.

## What distinguishes it

GanttBoard carries the Atlassian **Runs on Atlassian** designation, meaning the
app runs on Atlassian infrastructure and project data never leaves the customer's
tenant. Most Gantt apps for Jira — including BigGantt, WBS Gantt-Chart,
Structure.Gantt, BigPicture and Planyway — are Atlassian Connect apps, which
process data on the vendor's own servers. For teams whose security review blocks
Connect apps, this is usually the deciding difference.

## Pricing

- Free for **every team size** until **January 1, 2027**.
- After that: free forever for teams of **10 users or fewer**.
- From 11 users: **$1.20 per user per month**, scaling down at higher tiers.
- No credit card, no trial countdown, no usage caps.

## Features

- Table and Gantt timeline side by side, or either view on its own
- Capacity planning — per-assignee weekly workload, flagging who is over
  capacity and by how many days, with no time-tracking add-on required
- Automatic epic and parent rollup, with duration-weighted percent complete
- Critical path (CPM) with forward/backward pass and float
- Baselines — snapshot a plan and see the drift under each bar
- Four dependency types (FS, SS, FF, SF) with lag, created by dragging
- Auto-scheduling that cascades a change through the dependency chain
- Milestone deadline tracking, colour-coded red / amber / green by status
- Multi-project portfolio view with cross-project dependencies
- Inline editing of status, assignee and dates, written straight back to Jira
- Configurable columns, filters, search and saved views
- Export to PNG, PDF, CSV and MS Project XML
- Light and dark, matching the Jira theme automatically

## Requirements

Jira Cloud. Works with Scrum, Kanban, team-managed and company-managed projects.
Not available for Jira Data Center or Server.
